label: Rises at D2 after rare a2->S1, falls at D2 in S2; drops at GO after unrewarded trials, most after a1->S2 unrewarded.
short_terms: (phase == D2) * (action - 2*state + 1) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0)
terms: (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") ;; (phase != D2) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase != D2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1)
explanation: Raw GRU candidate n of unit 30. Timing dominates (high at D1, mid at GO, strongly negative at D2; R^2 0.89). Beyond timing: at D2 the reached state and the choice just made set the value: highest after a rare a2->S1 transition (+0.43), lower in S2 (especially rare a1->S2), with a1->S1 near baseline; the short form codes this as action - 2*state. At GO it falls after an unrewarded previous trial, and most strongly after a1->S2 unrewarded (-0.6); a1->S1 unrewarded and a2->S2 unrewarded give smaller drops, while a2 trials that were rewarded raise it. The free fit adds separate drops for the other unrewarded patterns, a small boost at D1/GO after an a2 choice, and a weak negative belief_lo slope (higher when the observer thinks S2 is good). The short form reaches about 77% of the free fit on dev (0.47 vs 0.61). All terms use only observed quantities (at D2 this trial’s choice and state are already observed).
